summary: fractal-web can be signed locally: scripts/st-test --all (and --check fractal-web) runs `nix develop .#web -c bash scripts/ci-local-web`, the web lane as one shard covering every kit play and app test, in an isolated home; the note records the shard and test-set inputs the policy's value rules read. When the base's own change detection finds no web input changed, st-test reports fractal-web as not relevant (status covered, run skipped), as CI does not run the lane either. The policy admits host and agent notes for pull requests through a new lane. Skipping stays off (enforce false).

replay.detail: A new local command, lane and host/agent signer levels for one check; no protocol or schema change.

schema.detail: A new local command, lane and host/agent signer levels for one check; no protocol or schema change.

rules.detail: The fractal-web wrapper kind now trusts host and agent notes for pull_request runs whose command is the new local lane's and whose inputs record one all-covering shard; merge_group still runs it, and enforce stays false, so nothing skips yet.

compatibility.detail: A new local command, lane and host/agent signer levels for one check; no protocol or schema change.

downtime.detail: A new local command, lane and host/agent signer levels for one check; no protocol or schema change.

manual.detail: None. A machine that signs it needs a Watchman service reachable at the account's default socket (Buck's file watcher); the operators provide one on the build hosts.

recovery.detail: Revert the policy and lane entries; CI keeps running and signing fractal-web as before.
